answer: The quartz counter is kept in ocean and dawn shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An copycat therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4044 identities would post 664 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
